Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class NonlinearVectorFunction

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.NonlinearVectorFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
VectorFunctionLike
public class NonlinearVectorFunction extends Object implements VectorFunctionLike
Light-weight nonlinear vector function carrier for use inside PreparedConstraint.

Wraps a user-supplied fun(x), jac(x), optional hess(x, v) triple, caching f and J at the iterate passed to the constructor. Subsequent fun(Matrix) / jac(Matrix) calls re-evaluate when x changes.

This class is the analytic-derivatives counterpart of scipy's VectorFunction when jac and hess are both supplied by the caller. The full VectorFunction carries the finite-difference / quasi-Newton fallbacks; this class skips them. NonlinearConstraint already resolves an FD Jacobian when the user omits one (its constructor wraps a 2-point NumDiff closure), so by the time we reach this class jac is always a working callable.

  • Constructor Details

    • NonlinearVectorFunction

      public NonlinearVectorFunction(Function<Matrix,Matrix> fun, Function<Matrix,Matrix> jac, BiFunction<Matrix,Matrix,Matrix> hess, Matrix x0, Optional<Boolean> sparseJacobian)
      Build a nonlinear vector function and cache f, J at x0.
      Parameters:
      fun - user constraint function R^n -> R^m
      jac - analytic Jacobian (or pre-built FD closure) R^n -> R^{m x n}
      hess - optional constraint Hessian-of-Lagrangian (x, v) -> Sum v[i] H_{f_i}(x); null is permitted (then hess(Matrix, Matrix) returns zeros)
      x0 - starting iterate (n x 1)
      sparseJacobian - Optional.of(true) forces sparse Jacobian storage; Optional.of(false) forces dense; Optional.empty() preserves whatever jac.apply(x0) returns
